resources.string: A floating UP / DOWN / DNT signal checker for Binance.US spot markets. It reads public candles and never places trades.

Target-aware 15-minute decision system: enter the exact Kalshi market strike manually. The target is used only as the binary ABOVE / BELOW finish line; no fixed-dollar buffer is applied. When price is below target, only confirmed bullish reversals can signal UP. When price is above target, only confirmed bearish reversals can signal DOWN. The 1-minute chart detects local exhaustion, momentum divergence, volume expansion or drying, and structural breaks; 5-minute and 15-minute structure add confirmation. The Strictness slider scales the required confirmation count, score threshold, and volume validation from Loose / Aggressive to Ultra-Strict. Each qualifying signal opens a 60-second entry window. This is a manual decision aid, not financial advice or an automatic trader.
